original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹湖泊州Yirol West知名摔跤手Alijou Nhial在朱巴去世
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据巴赫尔加扎勒地区摔跤迷及家属确认，来自湖泊州Yirol West县的知名摔跤手Alijou Nhial（绰号“Coronavirus”）因乙型肝炎和脑膜炎并发症，于周一凌晨3时30分在朱巴Nile King专科医院去世。Yirol West青年协会秘书长表示，逝者两个月前患病并转至朱巴治疗，当地将为其树立雕像以示纪念。

location.raw_text: Nile King Specialized Hospital in Juba

key_facts.fact: 来自湖泊州Yirol West县的摔跤手Alijou Nhial在朱巴Nile King专科医院去世
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the giant wrestler, Alijou Nhial, famously known as Coronavirus, who hails from Lakes State’s Yirol West County, died at Nile King Specialized Hospital in Juba

key_facts.fact: 死因据称为乙型肝炎和脑膜炎并发症
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: died at Nile King Specialized Hospital in Juba due to complications from Hepatitis B and meningitis at 3:30 A.M. on Monday

key_facts.fact: Yirol West青年协会秘书长称逝者两个月前患病并转至朱巴治疗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the deceased fell sick two months ago and was transferred to Juba for specialized treatment

key_facts.fact: 当地计划在Yirol West镇树立雕像以纪念该摔跤手
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a statue will be built in Yirol West Town to honor the fallen wrestler

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
